voice.noSettings: The server's settings cannot be asked ({why}).
voice.saved: Saved: the next call uses it.

answer.orchestrator: The manager of the farm chat itself takes the call: it sees how things are, sends work itself, and remembers what you said. Agora reaches one endpoint on this computer through a public address (voice.line.url in the configuration, such as Tailscale Funnel; cloudflared opened for the call when unset); only that endpoint is exposed, with a key per call.
answer.agora: A model hosted by Agora, no other key needed.
answer.deepseek: Uses the DeepSeek key in the settings ({from}).
answer.noDeepseek: Uses the DeepSeek key in the settings, which is not there yet: fill it in under Settings.
answer.openai: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: Qwen, Kimi, your own deployment…

voice.intro: The manager hears you and answers through Agora's conversational AI. Here you set up the line: the credentials, how it listens and who answers can all be hosted by Agora (no other key), or your own services. The manager's persona, greeting and voice are on the
voice.nextCall: Changes take effect on the next call
voice.areaHint: The region of Agora's endpoints: pick one near the server; projects in mainland China pick Mainland China.
voice.microsoft: Microsoft Azure speech, with your own key.
voice.hosted: Hosted by Agora, no other key needed.
voice.languageHint: Which language to hear. The persona should say to answer in it too.
voice.azureAreaHint: The region of the speech resource, such as eastasia or eastus.
voice.llmAddress: The full address of an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.
voice.dictationIntro: The record button by the farm chat's box: say something, stop, and it turns into text in the box for you to check before sending. The server passes the recording as is to the OpenAI-compatible transcription address below; with a local speech-server, the sound never leaves this computer.
voice.dictationAddress: Up to /v1. Local: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1; OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1. Empty turns dictation off.
voice.dictationModel: qwen3 for a local speech-server; gpt-4o-mini-transcribe for OpenAI.

persona.intro: How the manager opens a call and what voice it uses. The credentials, how it listens and who answers are on the
persona.ownCall: The manager takes the call itself: it is the manager of the farm chat, with its own prompt and no separate persona.
persona.personaHint: Who the model that answers first on the call is, and how it speaks. It cannot see how things are; the manager on this computer sends work. Tell it not to make up progress.
persona.greetingHint: The first thing said when the call connects.
persona.failureHint: What is said when the model fails.
persona.azureVoice: An Azure neural voice name, such as en-US-JennyNeural.
persona.minimaxVoice: Click a name to pick it, the play button on its left to hear it first; or fill in another MiniMax system voice id below.

dictation.unset: Dictation is not set up: fill in the address and the model under Dictation on the Voice page
dictation.failed: Last time it was not recognized: {why}
dictation.start: Dictation: click to start speaking, again to stop
dictation.label: Dictation

call.cannotHear: Agora: cannot hear the other side: {why}
